paragraphs.text:
The  journey  before  you  and  Norman  promises  to  be  long 
and hard.

If either of you require healing, you may restore 1 hit point each. To 
strike as direct a route as possible, go to 295. To hold parallel to the 
river’s course, go to 280. To search for existing trails, go to 297. To 
explore rocky terrain, go to 595. To camp first and regain a little 
strength, make a Luck roll: if you succeed, go to 296; if you fail, go 
to 298.
(82, 188, 190, 233, 241, 251, 278, 361, 442, 466, 467, 534, 565, 
594, 596)
